answers.answerContent: The streets where Thura, Khaing Khaing, and Zaw Zaw lived were the ones that were dirty and messy with trash.

i would very much like to live in a clean environment, where everything is neat and tidy. i want to live there because i wouldnt have to worry so much about cleaning and whenever i wake up, i can wake up to neat and tidy things, not dirty/messy

if the place im in is super dirty, i would feel disgusted, and feel stress, not freedom, but i would also have the idea of cleaning it. if the place i am at is clean, my mind will feel organized and free, not having to worry about anything

The homes and streets are dirty because the residents dont care about cleaness and throw trash carelessly instead of using bins.
becuase of that, it causes bad smells, spreads diseases, and leads to dangerous accidents like the monk's fall.
yes, and i feel so peacfull and free, lik everything is so in place and right, and it truly makes my day
